notes.title: modian is open
notes.content:
[p]Friends!
The crowdfunding for [i]My Time: College Diary[/i] on Modian starts today! 🎉[/p][p]This is a campus story game we’ve been working on for a long time. It’s packed with club activities, dorm life, juicy gossip, secret crushes… basically all the lively, slightly bittersweet moments of college life.[/p][p]Now we can finally tell you: the project is live! Come visit our Modian page and, if you feel like it, give us a little support. Every bit of backing gives us the confidence to keep telling stories; every message you leave is the motivation that keeps us up late writing.[/p][p][/p][p]Come on—let’s go through college again together in the game![/p]

notes.title: 摩点预热页面开启啦！！
notes.content:
[p]Hello everyone!
It’s been a while since our last update—huge thanks to all the friends who tried out the game and gave us feedback![/p][p]Over the past few weeks, we've been working hard on preparing materials for our crowdfunding campaign, and today, our pre-launch page is finally live! 🎉
Not only can you get the game’s Steam activation key at a super discounted price, but we’ve also prepared some beautiful merchandise just for you. Feel free to check it out and join us on the front row![/p][p]The crowdfunding campaign will officially launch on [b]August 15[/b]. You can find the Modian link in the description section, or simply search for [i]“University Diary”[/i] on Modian to find us.[/p][p]Thank you once again to everyone who's been supporting and accompanying us along the way![/p]

notes.title: Big Demo Extend Patch
notes.content: [p]Here is the English translation of your update:[/p][hr][/hr][p][b]Hello everyone, long time no see![/b][/p][p]Since the launch of the demo, we've received so much love and support from players — we're truly, deeply grateful for all your encouragement and feedback! It's thanks to your companionship that we've been able to keep polishing the game, step by step. We've been focusing intensively on development lately, so updates have been a bit slow — we really appreciate your patience and understanding![/p][p]To thank you for your enthusiastic support, we've decided to expand the demo content from [i]one semester[/i] to [i]a full academic year[/i]! That means you can continue having fun with your roommates and get even closer to the lovely girls![/p][p]The new semester brings brand-new content, including more storylines and all-new mini-games. We hope this makes your experience even richer and more enjoyable. We'll also keep listening to your voices and work hard to optimize and improve the game wherever we can.[/p][p]And a little teaser to end with — our crowdfunding campaign on Modian is in full preparation! Once the expanded demo content is ready, we’ll launch a preheat event soon. Please stay tuned and don’t forget to bookmark and support us in advance![/p][hr][/hr][h3]— Major Demo Expansion Update —[/h3][h3]— Bug Fixes —[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed several typos and voice-over issues[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where turning off the sound would automatically turn it back on[/p][/*][/list][h3]— Content Adjustments —[/h3][list][*][p]The demo now covers a full academic year. Time-consuming options will now be marked with a clock icon.[/p][/*][*][p]Added more random encounter events at Liudaokou.[/p][/*][*][p]New item added at Liudaokou: Protein Powder.[/p][/*][*][p]Nighttime can now be freely allocated.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced initial friendliness with Mom and added more text message interactions. You can now chat with Mom at specific times.[/p][/*][*][p]In the messaging system, untriggered conversations will now be marked, and important ones will have an exclamation mark.[/p][/*][*][p]Manual save slots increased to 30.[/p][/*][*][p]“Late-night phone chats” with the girls are now available.[/p][/*][*][p]Added text events with Zhao Weizheng and Lu Feng, which provide corresponding buffs.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a shortcut key (Esc) to open the menu.[/p][/*][*][p]The KTV at Liudaokou has been renamed to "Zongyou Studio" to align with future performances.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the scheduling of higher-level part-time jobs.[/p][/*][*][p]Reaching "friend" level with roommates now unlocks the ultimate version of mini-games.[/p][/*][*][p]Old save files are still compatible, but due to data adjustments, some stats may change.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]Let me know if you’d like this exported as a visual announcement or a formatted document![/p]

notes.title: Small patch/fix
notes.content:
——— Content Adjustments ———
Performing certain daily activities will now grant a small amount of basic attributes.
Choosing an engineering major will increase physique slightly.
Reduced attribute gains from the final event of each club in the first semester.
Increased the friendliness boost effect of some gifts.
——— Bug Fixes ———
Fixed an issue where buffs related to male friendliness were not working.
Fixed some buffs that were supposed to increase mood but had no effect.
Fixed an issue where nighttime values were unaffected by buffs.
Fixed a bug where giving gifts after reaching a friendly relationship with the heroine would cause the game to freeze.
Fixed a bug where different gifts given to different heroines resulted in the same friendliness change.
Added a scrollbar to the buff area.
Corrected some typos.

notes.title: Big adjust of player properties
notes.content:
---Content Adjustments---

Reduced Item Effects: The effectiveness of certain items has been decreased.
Detailed Attribute Enhancements: Attribute boosts in the task menu are now described in greater detail.
Experience Requirements Clarified: Requirements for attribute upgrades are now explained more thoroughly.
Mini-Game Skipping Option: Added the ability to skip mini-games. After winning three times with your roommates, mini-games can be skipped.
Club Semester-End Event Rewards: Successfully completing the final event of a club's first semester grants attribute boosts.
Charm Attribute Adjustment: Interaction point gain from charm attributes has been adjusted from +1 per 5 points to +1 per 3 points.
Intelligence Attribute Enhancement: Special effects have been added to the intelligence attribute.
Physique Attribute Enhancement: Special effects for the physique attribute have been improved.
Luck Attribute Adjustment: Dice quantity gain from luck attributes has been adjusted from +1 per 5 points to +1 per 3 points.
Reduced Hero Hall Meal Prices: The cost of dishes at the Hero Hall has been reduced.
End-of-Semester Event Adjustments: Dice roll requirements for some end-of-semester events have been adjusted.
Increased Work Requirements at Liudaokou: The requirements for working at Liudaokou have been raised.
Extended Tianxiang Talisman Effect: The effect duration of the Tianxiang Talisman has been increased to 30 days.
Milk Tea Shop Luck Boost: Luck attribute gains for drawing the Tianxiang Talisman or a first prize at the milk tea shop have been significantly increased.
Independent Attribute Display: Attributes provided by items are now displayed independently.
